label: What the predicates on AOPs, Key Events and KERs mean
description: Lists every predicate used on AOPs, Key Events or Key Event Relationships with its rdfs:label, rdfs:comment and number of uses. Many predicates are reused ontology terms whose own names are vague (nci:C25664 is Scale in NCIt, but here holds the level of biological organisation); the labels and comments in this endpoint say what AOP-Wiki stores under each. A good first query before writing others.
